title: COMMERCE BANCSHARES INC /MO/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Commerce Bancshares filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing Q1 2026 earnings results via referenced exhibits (press release and slide deck) without including actual financial figures in the filing body. The filing is furnished under Item 2.02 (Results of Operations) and explicitly states the information is not 'filed' for regulatory purposes.
key_points: Furnished under Item 2.02 as a non-material regulatory disclosure
Press release (Exhibit 99.1) and slide presentation (Exhibit 99.2) referenced but not embedded in the 8-K body
Signed by Paul A. Steiner, Controller (Chief Accounting Officer)
Company trades as CBSH on NASDAQ Global Select Market
No actual earnings figures, revenue, or earnings-per-share disclosed in the 8-K body itself
